newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Waterford Foods says finance director resigns.
newsitem.headline: Waterford Foods says finance director resigns.

text.p: Waterford Foods Plc said on Tuesday that it has accepted the resignation of Michael Dempsey as finance director.
The group said in a statement that the resignation is effective immediately.

Waterford Foods announced earlier that it had given its blessing to improved merger terms from rival Avonmore Foods Plc. Agreement was reached at a meeting of the boards of Waterford Foods Plc and its associated farmers' co-operative in the southern town of Dungarvan overnight on Monday.
A formal offer will be put to shareholders and co-op members for approval in the near future.
Avonmore's improved offer values the company at 337 million Irish pounds ($512 million) against an original offer of 281 million, the statement said.
If approved, it will weld together two of Ireland's premier food companies with a joint turnover of 2.5 billion pounds and pre-tax profits of 71.5 million.
To succeed the merger must be ratified by 75 percent of Waterford Co-op, which owns 68 percent of the Plc shares, and Waterford Foods Plc members.
